### 1 — Scene
A large vegetable salad with leafy greens, broccoli, shredded carrot, chicken pieces, and crumbled white cheese, likely feta.

### 2 — Vessel
A broad, shallow bowl, estimated **26 cm diameter**.  
Area = 3.14 × 13² ≈ **531 cm²**.

### 3 — Items
Visible foods: spinach or similar greens, broccoli, carrot, chicken, feta, yellow pepper, and a few cucumber-like green pieces. No clearly identifiable oil or dressing; none is added to the estimate.

### 4–7 — Area, volume, weight, and energy
Area shares partition the visible food coverage rather than counting overlapping ingredients twice. Heights describe each ingredient’s estimated pile envelope.

| Item | Area share | Area, cm² | Height, cm | Gross volume, ml | Density, g/ml | Weight, g | kcal/100 g | kcal |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Leafy greens | 25% | 133 | 2.5 | 332 | 0.15 | 50 | 23 | 12 |
| Broccoli | 23% | 122 | 2.3 | 281 | 0.55 | 154 | 34 | 52 |
| Shredded carrot | 13% | 69 | 1.0 | 69 | 0.50 | 35 | 41 | 14 |
| Chicken breast | 18% | 96 | 1.3 | 124 | 0.95 | 118 | 165 | 195 |
| Feta cheese | 10% | 53 | 0.8 | 42 | 0.95 | 40 | 265 | 106 |
| Yellow pepper | 4% | 21 | 1.0 | 21 | 0.60 | 13 | 27 | 4 |
| Cucumber-like pieces | 2% | 11 | 1.0 | 11 | 0.65 | 7 | 15 | 1 |

**Coverage check:** 25 + 23 + 13 + 18 + 10 + 4 + 2 = **95%**.

### 8 — Sanity check
The estimate totals **417 g and about 384 kcal**, plausible for this generously filled salad bowl. Bowl size and the amounts of chicken and cheese are the main uncertainties.
